service.method: UPDATE SADDR SET EMAIL = ${EMAIL}, PHONE_NO1 = ${PHONE_NO}, CHANGE_DATE = ${current.DATE}, CHANGE_TIME = ${current.TIME}, CHANGE_USER_ID = ${session.ID} WHERE 1=1 AND HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE} AND CODE_NO = ${USER_ID} AND CODE_TYPE = 'USER'

UPDATE SUSMT SET USER_NAME_LOC = ${USER_NAME_LOC}, USER_NAME_ENG = ${USER_NAME_ENG}, DEPT = ${DEPT_CODE}, POSITION = ${POSITION_CODE}, POSITION_NAME = ${POSITION_NAME}, LANGUAGE = ${LANGUAGE}, TIME_ZONE = ${TIME_ZONE}, EMAIL = ${EMAIL}, COUNTRY = ${COUNTRY}, MENU_PROFILE_CODE = ${MENU_PROFILE_CODE}, DATE_FORMAT = ${DATE_FORMAT}, EMPLOYEE_NO = ${EMPLOYEE_NO}, PHONE = ${PHONE_NO}, CHANGE_DATE = ${current.DATE}, CHANGE_TIME = ${current.TIME}, CHANGE_USER_ID = ${session.ID} WHERE 1=1 AND HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND USER_ID = ${USER_ID}

UPDATE SDEPT SET DEPT_NAME_LOC = ${DEPT_NAME_LOC}, DEPT_NAME_ENG = ${DEPT_NAME_ENG}, DEPT_NAME_JP = ${DEPT_NAME_JP}, DEPT_NAME_CN = ${DEPT_NAME_CN}, PARENT_DEPT = ${PARENT_DEPT}, MANAGER_ID = ${MANAGER_ID}, CHANGE_DATE = ${current.DATE}, CHANGE_TIME = ${current.TIME}, CHANGE_USER_ID = ${session.ID} WHERE 1=1 AND HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND DEPT = ${DEPT}

SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN LANGUAGE = 'KO' THEN TEXT1 ELSE NULL END) AS POSITION_NAME_LOC, MAX(CASE WHEN LANGUAGE = 'EN' THEN TEXT1 ELSE NULL END) AS POSITION_NAME_ENG, MAX(CASE WHEN LANGUAGE = 'JA' THEN TEXT1 ELSE NULL END) AS POSITION_NAME_JP, MAX(CASE WHEN LANGUAGE = 'ZH' THEN TEXT1 ELSE NULL END) AS POSITION_NAME_CN FROM SCODE WHERE 1=1 AND HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE} AND TYPE = 'UX049' AND CODE = ${POSITION_CODE}
